skill.summary: Summarizes publicly available videos and short drama pages from Xigua Video with metadata like titles, authors, engagement stats, and update status.

latestVersion.changelog:
xigua 0.1.1

- Initial release of the "西瓜视频" (xigua-video-hot-trend) skill.
- Supports extracting and summarizing public video, short drama, and topic page info from ixigua.com.
- Provides structured data such as video/short drama title, author, stats (like/comment/collect), episode info, and rankings.
- Adheres to compliance: no downloads, interface scraping, or bulk data collection; for public, lightweight analysis only.
- Offers suggested workflows for keyword summaries, drama episode extraction, and ranking statistics.
